summary: CCH Holdings Ltd, a Cayman Islands company with operations in Malaysia, filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, reporting that its Board adopted the 2026 Second Equity Incentive Plan on August 21, 2026. The plan authorizes the compensation committee to deliver up to 3,768,745 Class A ordinary shares (par value $0.0001) to attract and retain personnel. This is a routine equity incentive plan adoption, not a special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing contains no deal terms, no premium, or M&A activity, and merely reflects standard corporate governance and compensation mechanics.
